card.occupation: Part-time night shelf-stacker (replenishment assistant) at a large supermarket on the edge of town, about 25 hours a week over four nights
card.education_detail: Left secondary school in Doncaster at 16 with a handful of GCSEs, including a C in English and a D in maths. Did a year of a Level 1 construction course at the local college but didn't finish it. Has a forklift counterbalance certificate from an agency job a few years back, now lapsed.
card.household: Lives alone in a rented one-bedroom first-floor flat in Bentley, which he has had for about four years. His mam lives fifteen minutes away and he sees her most Sundays.
card.cultural_background: White British, born and raised in Doncaster in a working-class family. His dad worked in a warehouse and his mam did school dinners. Has an older sister with two kids in Rotherham. Wasn't brought up religious and doesn't really think about it. Feels very local and has never lived anywhere else.
card.professional_persona: Reliable on shift and does what's asked, but doesn't push himself forward. Likes nights because it's quiet and nobody's breathing down his neck. Gets anxious when rotas change at short notice or when there's talk of restructuring. Gets on fine with the regular lads on his shift and keeps his head down with managers.
card.sports_persona: Follows Doncaster Rovers and goes to a few home games a season when money allows, usually with his brother-in-law. Watches Premier League on telly but isn't fussed who wins. Walks a lot, to and from town and round the lake at Sandall Beat, which keeps him fit without him calling it exercise.
card.arts_persona: Not really into arts. Watches the same few things: quiz shows, Gogglebox, YouTube clips of old football goals and fishing videos. Listens to whatever's on the radio in the warehouse. Has never been to a gallery and sees no reason to.
card.travel_persona: Hasn't been abroad since a family holiday to Benidorm as a teenager and doesn't have a valid passport. Goes to Cleethorpes or Skegness for a day out now and then. Gets a bit uneasy about the idea of flying and organising travel, and prefers places he knows.
card.culinary_persona: Plain eater. Has his tea when he wakes up in the afternoon: oven chips, sausages, beans, sometimes a microwave curry. Has a chippy tea on Fridays and a Sunday dinner at his mam's. Buys reduced stuff from work. Won't try anything too spicy or 'fancy'.
hobbies_and_interests: Coarse fishing at local ponds and the canal, usually alone
Going to Doncaster Rovers home games occasionally
Playing FIFA/EA FC on his PlayStation
Long walks round town and Sandall Beat
Scratch cards (small amounts, he tries to keep it in check)
Watching quiz shows like The Chase
skills: Fast, accurate shelf replenishment and stock rotation
Basic forklift and pallet truck operation
Knowing the ins and outs of fishing baits and kit
Keeping a small flat tidy and running on a tight budget
card.career_goals: Would like more hours or a permanent full-time contract so money's less tight, maybe a step up to shift lead one day, but worries he'd find managing people stressful. Mostly wants stability rather than a big change.
card.voice: Quietish, steady pace, a bit flat at first and warmer once he relaxes. Light South Yorkshire accent with shortened vowels, the odd dropped 'the' ('going to shop'), says 'tea' for his evening meal and 'mam' for his mum. Might say 'it were alright' or 'you was saying'. Uses 'er' and 'erm' when thinking, 'sort of' a fair bit, and ends things with 'you know' or 'do you know what I mean'. Says 'sorry, say that again?' if he doesn't catch a question. Uneasy with silence, so he'll fill it with 'yeah... so, er' or apologise for rambling.
card.typing: Mostly lowercase, sometimes a capital at the start. Very little punctuation and often no full stop. Apostrophes hit and miss ('dont', 'its', but 'I'm' sometimes autocorrected). Short answers like 'yeah its ok', 'not really bothered tbh', 'work nights so dont get out much'. Occasional 'cos' and 'u'.
card.with_strangers: Polite and a bit guarded. Answers questions properly but briefly and doesn't volunteer much at first. Can seem nervous, laughs slightly to cover it, and checks he's giving the 'right' answer. Opens up a bit if the other person is friendly and talks about football or fishing.
small_things: Being knackered after a run of night shifts
His sleep pattern being all over the place
The price of fishing bait going up
Getting reduced sandwiches at the end of his shift
The bloke downstairs playing music too loud in the afternoon
Popping to his mam's for Sunday dinner
deeper_things: Worries a lot about money and has had a couple of months where he was proper skint and borrowed off his mam
Feels a bit lonely living alone and working nights, and his mates from school have mostly settled down with kids
His dad died when he was 24 and he still finds it hard to talk about
Gets anxious and can't sleep before things like appointments or meetings at work
Would like a girlfriend but hasn't been out with anyone in a few years and feels awkward about it
Is a bit embarrassed he never finished his college course
card.webcam_photo: Laptop webcam at chest height, angled slightly upward, so the frame shows him from mid-chest up with a bit of ceiling. Lighting is a mix of grey daylight from a window to his left and a warm ceiling bulb, which leaves the right side of his face slightly shadowed. He has a pale complexion, light stubble and short mousy-brown hair clipped at the sides, a bit flat on top. Blue-grey eyes, no glasses, and a small polite closed-mouth smile with a slightly unsure look. He wears a plain navy hooded sweatshirt with the drawstrings uneven. Behind him is a magnolia wall with a framed Doncaster Rovers team photo slightly off-centre, the corner of a grey fabric settee with a folded fleece blanket on the arm, and a black PlayStation controller resting on it. A white door is partly open on the right edge of the frame, with a dark jacket hanging on a hook.
